channel.title: RateLog — Warp changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for Warp, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: Warp — Free tier’s onboarding credit grant no longer listed
item.description: [↓ reduced] The live pricing page and pricing FAQ no longer mention a 150-then-75 monthly credit allowance for Free users; Free is now described as BYOK/pay-as-you-go only. No dated changelog entry found for when this changed — noting the date we confirmed it.

item.title: Warp — BYOK extended to Free tier
item.description: [↑ improved] Bring-your-own-API-key support was extended to all plans including Free.

item.title: Warp — Legacy tiers collapsed into one $20/mo plan
item.description: [↓ reduced] Collapsed three legacy paid tiers (Pro, Turbo, Lightspeed) into a single $20/mo Build plan; independent analysis characterized this as a net price increase for many existing $10–15/mo subscribers, even though per-unit overage pricing improved and BYOK access was added.
